name: Visitor visa (subclass 600)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing you'll leave Australia at the end of your visit.
This requires showing sufficient funds for the visit and return journey.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of sufficient funds and intent to leave

outcome.duration_length: up to 3, 6, or 12 months depending on stream and nationality

sources.title: Visitor visa (subclass 600) - Department of Home Affairs

notes: SCOPE NOTE: eligible passport holders from a shorter list of countries (broadly comparable/close partner nations) can instead use the simpler, cheaper ETA (subclass 601) or eVisitor (subclass 651) products rather than the full subclass 600 application — not modeled as separate route files here since they serve the identical functional purpose (short tourism/business visit, no work rights) with a lighter application process, a scope simplification consistent with how visa-exemption/lighter-process variants are handled elsewhere in this dataset (e.g. not separately modeling every EU visa-exemption list). Genuinely distinctive from the Schengen model used across every European country in this dataset: Australia has no equivalent single-instrument-covers-a-whole-bloc arrangement — each visit to Australia is assessed on its own terms rather than under a shared regional framework, worth flagging as a real structural contrast when comparing 'visit' category routes across this entire dataset.
